{
  "obligations": [
    {
      "text": "When relying on a third party for critical operational functions, the firm must take reasonable steps to avoid undue additional operational risk.",
      "actor": "firm",
      "action": "take reasonable steps to avoid undue additional operational risk",
      "condition": "when relying on a third party for the performance of operational functions which are critical for the performance of relevant services and activities on a continuous and satisfactory basis",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "2.1",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "The firm must not outsource important operational functions in a way that materially impairs the quality of its internal control.",
      "actor": "firm",
      "action": "not outsource important operational functions in a way that materially impairs the quality of its internal control",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "2.1",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "The firm must not outsource important operational functions in a way that materially impairs the PRA’s ability to monitor the firm’s compliance with all regulatory obligations.",
      "actor": "firm",
      "action": "not outsource important operational functions in a way that materially impairs the PRA’s ability to monitor the firm’s compliance with all regulatory obligations",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "2.1",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "The firm must not outsource important operational functions in a way that materially impairs a competent authority’s ability to monitor the firm’s compliance with MiFID II obligations.",
      "actor": "firm",
      "action": "not outsource important operational functions in a way that materially impairs a competent authority’s ability to monitor the firm’s compliance with MiFID II obligations",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "2.1",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "When outsourcing critical or important operational functions, the firm remains fully responsible for discharging all of its regulatory obligations.",
      "actor": "firm",
      "action": "remain fully responsible for discharging all regulatory obligations",
      "condition": "when outsourcing critical or important operational functions",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "2.1C",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "The firm must ensure that outsourcing does not result in senior management delegating its responsibility.",
      "actor": "firm",
      "action": "ensure outsourcing does not result in senior management delegating its responsibility",
      "condition": "when outsourcing critical or important operational functions",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "2.1C",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "The firm must ensure that the relationship and obligations towards its clients are not altered by outsourcing.",
      "actor": "firm",
      "action": "ensure the relationship and obligations towards its clients are not altered",
      "condition": "when outsourcing critical or important operational functions",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "2.1C",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "The firm must ensure that outsourcing does not undermine the conditions required to maintain its authorisation.",
      "actor": "firm",
      "action": "ensure outsourcing does not undermine the conditions required to maintain its authorisation",
      "condition": "when outsourcing critical or important operational functions",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "2.1C",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "The firm must ensure that outsourcing does not remove or modify any other conditions subject to which its authorisation was granted.",
      "actor": "firm",
      "action": "ensure outsourcing does not remove or modify any other conditions subject to which its authorisation was granted",
      "condition": "when outsourcing critical or important operational functions",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "2.1C",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "The firm must exercise due skill, care and diligence when entering into, managing or terminating any arrangement for outsourcing a critical or important operational function.",
      "actor": "firm",
      "action": "exercise due skill, care and diligence when entering into, managing or terminating any outsourcing arrangement",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "2.1D",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "The firm must ensure the service provider has the ability, capacity, sufficient resources and appropriate organisational structure to support reliable performance of the outsourced functions and any required authorisation.",
      "actor": "firm",
      "action": "ensure the service provider has ability, capacity, resources, organisational structure and required authorisation",
      "condition": "when entering into, managing or terminating a critical or important outsourcing arrangement",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "2.1D(1)",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "The firm must ensure the service provider carries out the outsourced services effectively and in compliance with applicable law and regulatory requirements, and must establish methods and procedures for assessing performance and ongoing review.",
      "actor": "firm",
      "action": "ensure the service provider carries out services effectively and in compliance, and establish assessment and review procedures",
      "condition": "when managing a critical or important outsourcing arrangement",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "2.1D(2)",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "The firm must ensure the service provider properly oversees the outsourced functions and adequately manages the associated outsourcing risks.",
      "actor": "firm",
      "action": "ensure the service provider properly oversees outsourced functions and manages outsourcing risks",
      "condition": "when managing a critical or important outsourcing arrangement",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "2.1D(3)",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "The firm must take appropriate action when it appears the service provider may not be carrying out the functions effectively or in compliance with applicable laws and regulatory requirements.",
      "actor": "firm",
      "action": "take appropriate action if the service provider may not be carrying out functions effectively or in compliance",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "2.1D(4)",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "The firm must retain the necessary expertise and resources to effectively oversee outsourced functions and manage associated risks.",
      "actor": "firm",
      "action": "retain necessary expertise and resources to oversee outsourced functions and manage risks",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "2.1D(5)",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "The service provider must disclose to the firm any development that may materially impact its ability to carry out the outsourced functions effectively and in compliance.",
      "actor": "service provider",
      "action": "disclose any development that may materially impact its ability to carry out outsourced functions effectively and in compliance",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "2.1D(6)",
      "severity": "medium"
    },
    {
      "text": "The firm must be able to terminate the outsourcing arrangement with immediate effect when it is in the interests of its clients, without detriment to continuity and quality of service.",
      "actor": "firm",
      "action": "terminate the outsourcing arrangement with immediate effect when in the interests of clients, without detriment to continuity and quality",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "2.1D(7)",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "The service provider must cooperate with the PRA and any other competent authority in connection with the outsourced functions.",
      "actor": "service provider",
      "action": "cooperate with the PRA and any other competent authority regarding outsourced functions",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "2.1D(8)",
      "severity": "medium"
    },
    {
      "text": "The firm, its auditors, the PRA and any other competent authority must have effective access to data and relevant business premises of the service provider for oversight purposes.",
      "actor": "firm, auditors, PRA, other competent authority",
      "action": "have effective access to data and relevant business premises of the service provider for oversight",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "2.1D(9)",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "The service provider must protect any confidential information relating to the firm and its clients.",
      "actor": "service provider",
      "action": "protect confidential information relating to the firm and its clients",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "2.1D(10)",
      "severity": "medium"
    },
    {
      "text": "The firm and the service provider must establish, implement and maintain a contingency plan for disaster recovery and periodically test backup facilities where necessary.",
      "actor": "firm and service provider",
      "action": "establish, implement and maintain a contingency plan for disaster recovery and periodically test backup facilities where necessary",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "2.1D(11)",
      "severity": "medium"
    },
    {
      "text": "The firm must maintain continuity and quality of outsourced functions or services in the event of termination, either by transferring them to another third party or performing them itself.",
      "actor": "firm",
      "action": "maintain continuity and quality of outsourced functions or services upon termination, by transferring or performing them itself",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "2.1D(12)",
      "severity": "high"
    }
  ]
}
